fields.note: Geometric Perry-Robertson with a0=s/1000 and eta=a0*r_o/rg^2. This is not a code eta table. SF is sigma_cr divided by the arch stress at p_ext. When N exceeds Ne the pole of 1/(1-N/Ne) is passed and that factor is not the score. The formula is a steel-column interaction. On CFRP, CNT and SiC it is a projection. It is scored beside Euler and yield and can bind below both.
